review_note: Drafted by one Claude session and reviewed by a different Claude session (6 of 40 tasks changed; log in evals/out/m11). All tasks are TEST tasks; no retrieval tool was run to write or review them, so nothing is tuned. The repository owner has not reviewed this set.

tasks.query: read the request payload chunk by chunk, reject it when it exceeds the body limit or does not match content-length, then hand it to the parser
tasks.note: rawBody accumulates data events, enforces the limit and content-length, and calls parser.fn with the collected body.

tasks.query: onSend handler for automatically exposed HEAD routes that computes content-length and discards the payload, resuming streams
tasks.note: headRouteOnSendHandler sets content-length (or resumes/cancels streams) and replaces the payload with null for HEAD responses.

tasks.query: copy headers from an error object onto the reply and choose the status code from error status or statusCode, defaulting to 500
tasks.note: setErrorHeaders applies error.headers and picks statusCode from status/statusCode >= 400 else 500.

tasks.query: check that a logger object has the info, error, debug, fatal, warn, trace and child methods and throw when methods are missing in strict mode
tasks.note: validateLogger filters the required method names and throws or returns false depending on strict.

tasks.query: convert the trustProxy option given as a function, true, hop count number, or comma-separated string into a trust function
tasks.note: getTrustProxyFn maps each accepted trustProxy shape to a predicate, compiling address lists via proxy-addr.

tasks.query: compile the response schemas for each status code and content type, rejecting keys that are not 2xx style status codes
tasks.note: compileSchemasForSerialization iterates schema.response, validates the status code key and stores compiled serializers on the context.

tasks.query: recursively freeze an object and its nested objects while skipping typed array views
tasks.note: deepFreezeObject walks own properties, skips ArrayBuffer views and freezes nested objects.

tasks.query: default request id generator that yields req- prefixed base36 counter values and wraps around at the maximum small integer
tasks.note: buildDefaultGenReqId returns a closure incrementing a masked counter formatted as req-<base36>.

tasks.query: handle a promise returned from a route handler: send the resolved payload if the reply is not already sent, or send the rejection as an error
tasks.note: wrapThenable attaches then handlers that call reply.send with the resolved value or the error.

tasks.query: expand the wildcard 0.0.0.0 bind address into the list of IPv4 addresses of the network interfaces, otherwise return the single address
tasks.note: getAddresses maps the 0.0.0.0 address to IPv4 network interface addresses.

tasks.query: when a TCP connection reports an idle timeout or oversized headers before a request is parsed, write a raw 408, 431 or 400 JSON response to the socket and destroy it
tasks.note: defaultClientErrorHandler picks 408/431/400 by err.code, writes a raw HTTP response to the socket and destroys it.

tasks.query: verify that the required framework release range in an extension's metadata matches the running release, tolerating candidate builds of the next major
tasks.note: checkVersion reads meta.fastify, allows RC builds, and throws FST_ERR_PLUGIN_VERSION_MISMATCH when semver does not satisfy.

tasks.query: last-resort router branch that warns this is likely a framework bug, prints the route table and replies with a 404 error object
tasks.note: fourOhFourFallBack logs the two bug warnings, prints the router and sends FST_ERR_NOT_FOUND with 404.

tasks.query: join the parent's URL mount path with an extension's mount path, making sure exactly one slash separates the two parts
tasks.note: buildRoutePrefix concatenates instance and plugin prefixes, adding or removing a slash at the junction.

tasks.query: function used as a socket idle-event listener: it reads the context, request and reply stored on the socket and runs the registered hooks with an empty callback
tasks.note: handleTimeout is the 'timeout' listener registered in routeHandler; it reads this._meta and runs onTimeoutHookRunner with the context's onTimeout hooks and a noop callback.

tasks.query: prepare a route's validation definitions: alias query to querystring, fail if both are set, unwrap fluent builder values, require inner definitions for media types, mark as visited
tasks.note: normalizeSchema aliases query, throws on duplicates, converts fluent schemas, validates content entries and sets kSchemaVisited.

tasks.query: track every open multiplexed-protocol connection via events, dropping ones that receive goaway or frame errors, and return a function that terminates the remaining ones
tasks.note: createCloseHttp2SessionsByHttp2Server keeps a Set of sessions updated by events and returns closeHttp2Sessions that closes them.

tasks.query: on each matched HTTP call, create an id and scoped logger, refuse with 503 during shutdown, track keep-alive sockets, build request and reply, arm the deadline timer, start onRequest hooks
tasks.note: routeHandler is the per-request entry: id, child logger, 503 on closing, keep-alive tracking, Request/Reply construction, handler timeout, then hooks.

tasks.query: final stage of writing a response: declare trailers, unwrap a Fetch Response, omit content-length for 204 and 304, dispatch streams, else compute content-length and write head and body
tasks.note: onSendEnd handles trailers, Response objects, empty payloads, stream dispatch and writes head plus payload with content-length.

tasks.query: instantiate the structured log backend, refusing both an output stream and a file path, opening the file destination, or deriving a child from a supplied instance with merged serializers
tasks.note: createPinoLogger validates stream/file, opens pino.destination, and either builds a child of the previous logger or a new pino instance.

tasks.query: how does a GET route automatically get a matching HEAD route that returns the same headers, including content-length, but no body
tasks.note: addNewRoute registers the HEAD twin via prepareRoute with parseHeadOnSendHandlers, whose headRouteOnSendHandler drops the body and sets content-length.

tasks.query: registering a custom not-found handler on a plugin scope with its own prefix, including the public instance method and the internal router setup
tasks.note: The instance method delegates to four-oh-four's setNotFoundHandler, which defers to _setNotFoundHandler to build the context and router entries.

tasks.query: how an incoming POST body is parsed based on its Content-Type header: header parsing, rejecting invalid media types, and reading the raw payload
tasks.note: handleRequest parses the header with ContentType and runs the parser machinery, whose rawBody collects the payload.

tasks.query: how route JSON definitions become validator functions at startup and are then applied to params, body, query and headers of an incoming request before the handler runs
tasks.note: setupValidator builds the compiler, compileSchemasForValidation stores validators on the context, and preValidationCallback calls validate per request. The startup wiring (normalizeSchema, setupValidator, compileSchemasForValidation calls in the preReady hook) lives in addNewRoute in route.js.

tasks.query: how a reply payload is serialized: honoring a custom reply serializer, else using a per-status-code response definition, else falling back to JSON stringify
tasks.note: preSerializationHookEnd picks the reply serializer or falls to serialize, which asks getSchemaSerializer for the per-status/content-type function and else uses JSON.stringify.

tasks.query: how a thrown or passed error becomes an HTTP response: run the error hooks, choose the current error handler in the chain, and fall back to a minimal serialized error when the handler fails
tasks.note: onErrorHook runs onError hooks then handleError, which invokes the handler chain and finally fallbackErrorHandler.

tasks.query: what happens after the server starts listening on localhost: binding the extra resolved addresses, logging the address and running the onListen hooks
tasks.note: listenCallback starts and reports listening, multipleBindings adds secondary servers, and onListenHookRunner runs the hooks.

tasks.query: how a per-request identifier is produced, optionally taken from an incoming header, and attached to the request-scoped logger
tasks.note: reqIdGenFactory/buildOptionalHeaderReqId generate the id and createChildLogger binds it to the child logger.

tasks.query: adding custom properties to the request and reply classes so that child scopes inherit them when instances are constructed
tasks.note: decorateConstructor records props on the constructor and buildRegularRequest/buildReply copy those props onto each new instance.

tasks.query: how a request whose URL path cannot be decoded is answered: the main router's handler honoring a custom framework-error callback, and the router used for not-found scopes
tasks.note: fastify.js onBadUrl answers bad URLs for the main router (frameworkErrors or 400 JSON) while createOnBadUrl builds the 404 router's equivalent.
